raw_comment: I notice that there is less drought along the coastlines, but the United States is a country that does experience many droughts. I wonder what the effect of drought does to the country and how it affects the people who live in areas where they are severe droughts. This relates to me and my community since I live in the United States and have family and friends in areas where there are a lot of droughts. I would title this graph "Levels of Drought Across the United States."
